name: Aktiv Camping Prutz
beschreibung:
=== beschreibung ===

Aktiv Camping Prutz is located in the municipality of Prutz in the Tiroler Oberland region. The campsite provides pitches for RVs, caravans, and tents. The site features modern sanitary facilities and a children’s playground. Guests can enjoy rafting on the Inn River or hiking in the area. The campsite is perfect for families and active travelers, offering easy access to explore the Kaunertal region.
